name: Administrative Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  MONDAY, JUNE 12, 2023 - 3:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model.  The Public may join this meeting virtually or
attend in-person at City Hall.

Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
11:00 a.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Administrative Committee
Members prior to the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-
Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:.
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82365623372
  Webinar ID: 823 6562 3372
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,82365623372# or +16699009128,,82365623372#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 205 0468 or +1 253 215 8782

Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Committee Chair.
The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to speak must “raise their hand”, at
which time they will be unmuted.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
Committee-Supplemental-Packets
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Davis

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Administrative Committee on items not on the printed agenda.
Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or
otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda.
When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to City Staff prior to the meeting starting.

BUSINESS:

1.  Greater Conejo Chamber of Commerce Agreement – Review and discussion
  of the proposed 2023-2026 Greater Conejo Chamber of Commerce Proposal for
  Economic Development.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 8, 2023 at 5:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.
